<description>
I was researching coin selection when I came across this bug, so I thought I'd fix it

Pr #33223  adjusts  weight selection to keep the lighter coin when two coins have the same value, but the test has two mistakes, as confirmed in this [comment ](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36255#discussion_r4432516127)

1. It builds `mixed_weight_pool` but passes `utxo_pool` to `TestSRDSuccess`.
2. There is nothing enforcing coin eviction because the current max weight (`4 * 3 * 67` = 804 WU) fits any two coins (544 WU)

If you reverse #33223, it still passes, which means it misses the tie-break

### The fix
The test now uses `mixed_weight_pool and adds an extra light coin so that only two light coins can fit together and evicts a coin on every tie to pass.
Lowers the max weight to 536 WU; SRD now has to evict the heavier coin on every tie to succeed

This should show failed tests with [bitcoin#33223](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/33223) reverted and pass on master.
</description>
